headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.4
summary: The log overlay no longer pushes the full 10000-line capture through the UI when the game resumes, fixing the app-not-responding dialog at game startup.

items.text: With App-Level Logging enabled, resuming the game replayed the entire 10000-line capture into the log overlay's RecyclerView on the main thread, freezing game startup on low-RAM devices. The on-screen history is now capped at 300 lines while exports keep the full capture.
